territorial_scope.description: Issued by the Superior Electoral Court and applicable to electoral propaganda in Brazilian elections, with the electoral justice as the enforcing authority.

evidence.quote: O TRIBUNAL SUPERIOR ELEITORAL, no uso das atribuições que lhe conferem

summary.short: Amends TSE Resolution 23.610/2019 on electoral propaganda. Requires disclosure of AI-generated or manipulated campaign content and bans new synthetic content of candidates near polling day. Restricts AI systems from ranking or recommending candidates, requires compliance plans from internet application providers, and takes effect on publication.
summary.long: Resolution of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) of 2 March 2026 amending TSE Resolution 23.610/2019 on electoral propaganda; it takes effect on publication (Art. 2). AI provisions (Art. 9-B) require whoever uses AI-generated or manipulated multimedia content in electoral propaganda to disclose explicitly and accessibly that the content was manufactured or manipulated and which technology was used, including on each page or face of printed material. Publishing, republishing or paid boosting of new synthetic content using the image, voice or statements of a candidate or public figure is barred from 72 hours before to 24 hours after the end of the election (Art. 9-B §3-A); non-compliance requires immediate removal or service suspension by the application provider or by court order (Art. 9-B §4). Application providers offering AI systems may not rank, recommend or favour candidates, alter sexual or nude imagery of candidates, or create electoral advertising depicting political violence against women (Art. 28 §1-C). Judges may reverse the burden of proof in synthetic-content cases (Art. 9-I). Internet application providers must prepare a compliance plan with measurable indicators, which is a requirement for credentialing and registration (Art. 125-B). The resolution also amends rules on campaign events and live streams (Art. 3), paid boosting with a public repository (Art. 3-B), profile removal (Art. 38-A), coercive fines for breach of Art. 15 (Art. 15 §5), and free-airtime allocation by gender, race and indigenous candidacies (Arts. 53, 77).

Internal citation gaps: art. 3-B cites 'Resolução nº 23.732/2024/TSE, art. 27-A' while other markers cite the resolution alone; art. 9-B § 5º refers to § 1º of art. 9-B, which is not reproduced; art. 125-B cites arts. 27-A § 4º and 29 § 9º and '9-E' (no º), none reproduced. Target instrument IDs are empty because registry IDs were not checked. The text states it does not replace the DJE-TSE publication (nº 30, Edição Extraordinária, 4.3.2026, p. 93-102); it is dated 2 March 2026. section_status is set to not_applicable only because the schema requires it; relations and entities are populated.

thresholds.conditions: Applies even where the content is labelled and complies with the other requirements of Art. 9º-B.

obligations.summary: Intra-party propaganda on the internet must observe, where applicable, arts. 57-C to 57-J of Lei 9.504/1997. Addressees are political parties and federations, for which the vocabulary has no closer role.

evidence.quote: A veiculação de propaganda intrapartidária na internet deverá observar, no que for aplicável, as disposições dos arts. 57-C a 57-J da Lei nº 9.504/1997.

obligations.summary: Live transmission of party-related acts is limited to profiles and channels of pre-candidates, parties, coalitions and federations; transmission or retransmission by radio or TV broadcasters, or on sites or profiles owned by legal persons, is prohibited. Addressees are broadcasters and legal persons, as the vocabulary has no closer role.

evidence.quote: vedada a transmissão ou retransmissão por emissoras de rádio, por emissoras de televisão ou em site, perfil ou canal pertencente a pessoa jurídica

obligations.summary: Paid boosting of political content is allowed only where contracted by a party, federation or candidate directly with the provider, with unequivocal identification that the content is boosted and a public repository of boosting data. The text's subject for the repository duty is unclear.

evidence.quote: com identificação inequívoca de que se trata de conteúdo impulsionado, devendo manter repositório público com dados sobre o impulsionamento

obligations.summary: Use of symbols or images in convoked broadcast networks is prohibited, except those in art. 13 §1 of the Federal Constitution.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only when broadcast network convocation is permitted.

evidence.quote: é vedada a utilização de símbolos ou imagens, exceto aqueles previstos no § 1º do art. 13 da Constituição Federal

obligations.summary: The person responsible for electoral propaganda using AI-generated or manipulated multimedia synthetic content must explicitly, prominently and accessibly disclose that the content was fabricated or manipulated and which technology was used. Art. 9-B IV extends this to each page or side of printed material.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies when AI or equivalent technology is used to create, replace, omit, merge, alter speed or overlay images or sounds in electoral propaganda.

evidence.quote: impõe ao responsável pela propaganda o dever de informar, de modo explícito, destacado e acessível, que o conteúdo foi fabricado ou manipulado e qual tecnologia foi utilizada

obligations.summary: Publication, republication (even free of charge) and paid boosting of new synthetic content made or altered by AI that uses the image, voice or statements of a candidate or public figure are prohibited, even if labelled, in the window around the election.
obligations.applies_from: no période compreendido entre as 72 (setenta e duas) horas que antecedem e as 24 (vinte e quatro) horas que sucedem o término do pleito
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only in the window of 72 hours before to 24 hours after the end of the election.

evidence.quote: Ficam vedadas a publicação e a republicação, ainda que gratuitas, bem como o impulsionamento pago de novos conteúdos sintéticos

obligations.summary: Providers offering paid boosting of political-electoral content must enable a specific field for the propaganda's responsible party to declare the use of AI, without prejudice to the duties in §1.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to providers that offer boosting of political-electoral content.

evidence.quote: devem viabilizar campo específico para que o responsável pela propaganda declare o uso de inteligência artificial ou de tecnologia equivalente

obligations.summary: When ordering suspension of a profile, the judge must state the validity period of the measure.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies when a judge orders suspension of a profile under art. 9-D.

evidence.quote: indicará o prazo de vigência da medida

obligations.summary: The competent court may, ex officio or on request of the representation's author, order other application providers to be notified to act preventively against the content listed in art. 9-E VI.
obligations.conditional_on: Discretionary power of the competent court, ex officio or on request.

evidence.quote: poderá, de ofício ou a requerimento do autor da representação, determinar a cientificação dos demais provedores de aplicação

obligations.summary: Application providers must implement a specific solution allowing candidates, parties, federations and coalitions to report violations of art. 9-E.

evidence.quote: Os provedores de aplicação devem implementar solução específica que permita

obligations.summary: Electoral courts may enter agreements with universities and entities with professionals trained in digital-offence forensics and AI for work on election cases. Candidates, parties, federations and coalitions are not obliged to hire such professionals.

evidence.quote: Os Tribunais Eleitorais poderão firmar acordos com universidades

obligations.summary: Electoral propaganda or electoral harassment in public or private workplaces is prohibited; whoever causes or permits it is responsible under the law in force.

evidence.quote: É vedada a propaganda eleitoral ou o assédio eleitoral em ambiente de trabalho público ou privado

obligations.summary: For majoritarian-election flyer distribution, a Braille offer is required, in graduated proportion (§3); the Braille printing must follow the share of visually impaired people in the electoral roll of the constituency (§4). Addressees are parties, federations, coalitions or candidates, as the vocabulary has no closer role.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to flyer or leaflet distribution for majoritarian elections.

evidence.quote: impõe sua oferta em sistema Braille, em proporção escalonada

obligations.summary: The TSE must publish on its website, by 20 July, the percentage of visually impaired people to which the Braille printing duty refers.

evidence.quote: O Tribunal Superior Eleitoral publicará, até o dia 20 de julho, na sua página na internet, o percentual

obligations.summary: Providers of application that offer AI systems may not, even at user request, rank, recommend, suggest or prioritise candidates, campaigns, parties or coalitions; express electoral opinions or preference; alter sexual or nudity imagery of a candidate; or create electoral advertising representing political violence against women.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to application providers that offer AI systems or equivalent technology.

evidence.quote: É vedado aos provedores de aplicação que ofertem sistemas de inteligência artificial ou por tecnologia equivalente

obligations.summary: In the cases of §4-A (false information on the electronic voting system, incitement of crimes against the democratic rule of law, subversion of the constitutional order, political violence against women), the provider must make the illicit content unavailable regardless of a court order, and must communicate the reasons for removal to the user and allow appeal.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to the cases listed in §4-A.

evidence.quote: o provedor de aplicação de internet deve adotar as providências necessárias para tornar indisponível o conteúdo ilícito, independentemente de determinação judicial

obligations.summary: Electoral propaganda on websites or social-network profiles is prohibited, even free of charge. Addressees are the propaganda's promoters, as the vocabulary has no closer role.

evidence.quote: é vedada, ainda que gratuitamente, a veiculação de propaganda eleitoral na internet em sítios ou perfis em redes sociais

obligations.summary: Paid electoral propaganda includes any contracting, including through competition, ranking or prize mechanisms offering economic advantage to natural or legal persons to publish political-electoral content on their profiles, pages, channels or sites. These forms are prohibited.

evidence.quote: Incluem-se entre os tipos de propaganda eleitoral paga vedados pelo caput deste artigo a contratação sob qualquer modalidade

obligations.summary: Providers may delete profiles only where they are false, automated or bots; deletion in other cases is not permitted. Removal under art. 38-A is otherwise done in judicial proceedings with due process.

evidence.quote: É permitida a exclusão pelos provedores de aplicação apenas nas hipóteses de perfis falsos, automatizados ou robô.

obligations.summary: From 15 August of the election year, the Electoral Justice must convene parties, federations, coalitions and broadcasters' representation to prepare, within 5 days before free electoral propaganda starts, a media plan for the free electoral airtime.
obligations.applies_from: a partir de 15 de agosto do ano da eleição

evidence.quote: a Justiça Eleitoral deve convocar os partidos políticos, as federações, as coligações e a representação das emissoras de rádio e de televisão para elaborar

obligations.summary: The media plan must include information on the distribution of time, indicating the percentage allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people. Addressees are the parties and broadcasters that prepare the plan.

evidence.quote: informação a respeito da distribuição do tempo, indicando o percentual destinado às candidaturas de mulheres

obligations.summary: Electoral propaganda files must be delivered to broadcasters with the Annex IV form, which contains a field for the percentage of the programme allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people.

evidence.quote: acompanhados do formulário do Anexo IV desta Resolução

obligations.summary: Free airtime is distributed in proportion to the percentage of candidacies of women (Black, non-Black and Indigenous), of men (Black, non-Black and Indigenous), and of Indigenous candidacies (§1-A, §3-A), based on registration requests. Any shortfall in a weekly cycle must be compensated in following weeks until the end of the campaign (§6).

evidence.quote: destinação proporcional ao percentual de candidaturas de mulheres negras, não negras e indígenas

obligations.summary: Electoral courts must make available on their websites information on free propaganda time allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people, drawn from the party data in Annexes III and IV.

evidence.quote: os tribunais eleitorais disponibilizarão, em suas páginas na internet, informação sobre o tempo de propaganda gratuita

obligations.summary: The TSE must promote institutional broadcast advertising of up to 5 minutes per day to encourage participation of women, young people and Black and Indigenous people, and to explain the electoral system.
obligations.applies_from: entre 1º de abril e 30 de julho dos anos eleitorais

evidence.quote: promoverá, em até 5 (cinco) minutos diários, contínuos ou não, requisitados às emissoras de rádio e televisão, propaganda institucional

obligations.summary: Internet application providers must prepare a compliance plan to prevent and mitigate risks to electoral integrity and to comply with listed articles (9-B to 40). The plan must contain compliance measures per provision, measurable indicators, and deadlines and expected results (§1). Compliance is a condition for accreditation under art. 27-A §4 and for the registry under art. 29 §9 (§2).
obligations.conditional_on: Under the terms, deadlines and guidelines issued by the TSE Presidency.

evidence.quote: Os provedores de aplicação de internet deverão, nos termos, prazos e diretrizes editados pela Presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, elaborar plano de conformidade

obligations.summary: The TSE Presidency issues the terms, deadlines and guidelines for the compliance plans. The portaria implementing them is to be published in the Diário de Justiça Eletrônico (§3).

evidence.quote: nos termos, prazos e diretrizes editados pela Presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral

enforcement.authority: Provedor de aplicação de internet (por iniciativa própria) ou Poder Judiciário (por determinação judicial)
enforcement.triggered_by: Descumprimento das regras do caput e dos §§ 3º e 3º-A do art. 9º-B (conteúdo sintético em propaganda eleitoral e proibição de publicação nas 72 horas antes e 24 horas após o pleito)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text; the measure is removal of content or unavailability of the communication service.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not applicable: the text prescribes content removal or service unavailability, not a monetary penalty.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Sem prejuízo de apuração nos termos do § 2º do art. 9º-C (not reproduced in this text)
enforcement.cure_period: Immediate removal ('imediata'); no cure period stated.

evidence.quote: O descumprimento das regras previstas no caput e nos §§ 3º e 3º-A deste artigo impõe a imediata remoção do conteúdo ou indisponibilidade do serviço de comunicação

enforcement.triggered_by: Determination of suspension of a profile referred to in the preceding paragraph of art. 9º-D (that paragraph is not reproduced in this text)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Not stated; the judge sets the duration of the measure.
enforcement.cure_period: Duration set by the judge ('prazo de vigência'); no cure period stated.

evidence.quote: A juíza ou o juiz, ao determinar a suspensão de perfil referida no parágrafo anterior, indicará o prazo de vigência da medida.

enforcement.authority: Justiça Eleitoral (judicial process, § 1º); provedores de aplicação (exclusion, § 2º)
enforcement.triggered_by: Reiterated publications by a false, anonymous or automated profile that constitute electoral crime or notoriously false or grossly decontextualized facts recognized by the Electoral Justice
enforcement.penalty_reference: None cited in this text; § 3º refers to art. 9º-D, § 5º for other cases.

evidence.quote: A remoção de perfil será feita quando se tratar de usuário comprovadamente falso

enforcement.authority: Court issuing the judicial order (not further specified in this text)
enforcement.triggered_by: Violation of art. 15 and its paragraphs (the subject of art. 15 is not reproduced in this text)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Daily fine (astreintes); no amount stated in this text.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Daily fine ('multa diária') to ensure effectiveness of the judicial order; amount not stated; Código de Processo Civil applies subsidiarily.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Código de Processo Civil (applied subsidiarily; no article cited)

evidence.quote: A violação do disposto neste artigo e em seus parágrafos poderá ensejar a adoção de medidas coercitivas

enforcement.authority: Not stated in this text (Código Eleitoral criminal provisions cited)
enforcement.triggered_by: Producing, offering or selling a video with false content about parties or candidates
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Same penalties as the caput of art. 90 (caput not reproduced in this text); no amount stated.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Código Eleitoral, art. 323, § 1º (cited); caput of art. 90 (not reproduced in this text)
